mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my walls for paneling installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before wall paneling installation, ensure your walls are clean, dry, and free from any loose debris or peeling paint. Any significant holes or cracks should be repaired and patched to provide a smooth, stable surface. For optimal results, existing wallpaper should be removed. We recommend clearing furniture away from the walls and protecting floors to create an unobstructed workspace. Hometelligent Inc. conducts a thorough pre-installation inspection to identify any necessary repairs or preparations, ensuring a solid foundation for your new paneling.
